Along the cycle, the arcs not entering node 1 force u to rise by at least 1 each step. The closing arc then requires u[1] >= u[k] + 1, which contradicts that increase around the full cycle. Summing the constraints over all arcs of the cycle gives 0 >= 5, which is impossible. So every tour is infeasible, which matches the solver's "infeasible" status.
